description: Structured eval definitions for the AWS IoT SiteWise Asset Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across SiteWise modeling scenarios (asset model with measurement/transform/metric/attribute + OPC-UA gateway, parent-child hierarchy with metric aggregation, cloud-direct ingestion via alias, dashboard and portal with Identity Center SSO + threshold alarms, missing Greengrass core device prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: SiteWise asset model with all four property types and OPC-UA gateway
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — measurement/transform/metric/attribute model, OPC-UA gateway with node-to-alias mappings, alias-based ingestion path
eval_cases.prompt: Create a SiteWise asset model named "Pump Station" in us-east-1. Measurement properties: FlowRate (DOUBLE, m3/s), Pressure (DOUBLE, kPa), Temperature (DOUBLE, C), Vibration (DOUBLE, mm/s). Transform property: TemperatureF = Temperature * 9/5 + 32. Metric property: HourlyAvgFlow = AVG(FlowRate, 3600s). Attribute property: Manufacturer (STRING), SerialNumber (STRING). Gateway "Plant Gateway" on Greengrass core device GreengrassCore-001. OPC-UA source from opc.tcp://10.0.1.50:4840 with 4 node mappings to aliases /plant/area1/pump1/*. Account 123456789012. Tags: Environment=production, Site=PlantA.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SITEWISE: Pump Station (model-xxx) → asset-id
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Property types: measurement(4), transform(1), metric(1), attribute(2)
  [✓] Transform expressions: validated (TemperatureF)
  [✓] Metric processing configs: validated (HourlyAvgFlow=3600s)
  [✓] Gateway: Plant Gateway — RUNNING
  [✓] OPC-UA source: opc.tcp://10.0.1.50:4840, 4 node mappings
  [✓] Asset property aliases: /plant/area1/pump1/*
  [✓] Data ingestion path: OPC-UA → gateway → measurement properties
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws iotsitewise describe-asset-model --asset-model-id <model-id>
  aws iotsitewise describe-gateway --gateway-id <gateway-id>

eval_cases.name: Parent-child asset hierarchy with parent-level metric aggregation
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — hierarchy defined in parent model, child assets associated, parent metric aggregates child measurements
eval_cases.prompt: Create a SiteWise asset hierarchy in us-east-1. Parent model "Production Line" with metric property TotalOutput = SUM(PowerOutput, 300s) aggregated across child assets. Child model "Machine" with measurement properties: PowerOutput (DOUBLE, kW), Temperature (DOUBLE, C), Status (STRING). Hierarchy name "Contains Machines". Parent asset "Line-A" with child assets "Machine-01" and "Machine-02". Account 123456789012. Tags: Facility=Factory1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SITEWISE: Production Line → Line-A
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Asset hierarchy: Production Line → Machine via Contains Machines
  [✓] Metric processing configs: validated (TotalOutput=300s)
  [✓] Asset(s): Line-A (parent), Machine-01, Machine-02 (children)
  [✓] Hierarchy associations: Line-A → Machine-01, Machine-02

eval_cases.name: Cloud-direct ingestion via BatchPutAssetPropertyValue with property aliases
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — measurement model with alias, storage config, cloud-direct ingestion (no gateway)
eval_cases.prompt: Create a SiteWise asset model "Temperature Sensor" in us-east-1 with measurement property Reading (DOUBLE, Celsius). Set alias /buildings/hq/sensor1/reading on the property. Cloud-direct ingestion via BatchPutAssetPropertyValue (no gateway). Storage warm tier 180 days. Account 123456789012. Tags: Environment=production, Building=HQ.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SITEWISE: Temperature Sensor
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Property types: measurement(1)
  [✓] Asset property aliases: /buildings/hq/sensor1/reading
  [✓] Data ingestion path: BatchPutAssetPropertyValue → alias
  [✓] Storage configuration: warm tier (180 days)

eval_cases.name: SiteWise dashboard and SSO portal with Identity Center and threshold alarms
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — SSO portal with Identity Center, project, dashboard, threshold alarm with duration, access policy
eval_cases.prompt: Create a SiteWise project "Plant Monitoring" and portal "Acme Plant Portal" with SSO auth mode (Identity Center instance ssoins-12345). Role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/SiteWisePortal. Asset model "Compressor" with measurement Pressure (DOUBLE, kPa) and alarm HighPressure (Pressure GT 800 for 10 minutes). Dashboard "Compressor Overview" in the project. Assign group arn:aws:iam::123456789012:group/Operators as VIEWER on the project. Account 123456789012. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SITEWISE: Compressor
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Portal: Acme Plant Portal — auth mode SSO, alarms ENABLED
  [✓] Identity Center: configured (ssoins-12345)
  [✓] Access policies: Operators → Plant Monitoring (VIEWER)
  [✓] Alarms: HighPressure (Pressure > 800 kPa, 10 min duration)
  [✓] Dashboard: Compressor Overview in Plant Monitoring

eval_cases.name: SiteWise Edge gateway with unregistered Greengrass core device (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — Greengrass core device 'MyCoreDevice' is not registered in Greengrass V2
eval_cases.prompt: Create a SiteWise gateway "Factory Gateway" on Greengrass core device "MyCoreDevice" that is NOT yet registered in Greengrass V2. OPC-UA source from opc.tcp://10.0.2.30:4840. Asset model "Pump" with measurement FlowRate. Account 123456789012. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SITEWISE: Pump
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Gateway: Greengrass core device 'MyCoreDevice' is NOT registered in Greengrass V2
